title: WAL index-memory mode and file observations

scope.rationale: sqlite3WalHeapMemory identifies a non-null WAL using a connection-private heap index, while sqlite3WalFile returns the WAL file handle.
excluded_responsibilities: Opening or closing the WAL file

external_source_responsibilities: Wal.open selects native shared-index publication or private index mode
Wal.openFile owns lazy WAL file allocation and close
dependencies.caller_closure: Both complete observations are assigned; Pager journal-file selection consumes walFile and runtime trace covers null/shared-index and lazy-file transitions.

inputs: Nullable borrowed Wal for index-mode query
Mutable borrowed Wal for file query
outputs: Heap-index boolean or nullable borrowed sqlite3_file handle
contracts.ownership: Pure borrowed observations; no ownership transfer.
contracts.state_and_results: Missing WAL is not heap-memory. A Wal that does not publish the native shared index uses a connection-private index. walFile returns the exact currently open WAL handle and null before lazy open.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: No locks, callbacks, or I/O; callers own synchronization.

representation_differences: Runtime Wal names the inverse source state publish_native_index; false corresponds to connection-private heap index mode.
Zig walFile returns an optional typed pointer because the runtime WAL file opens lazily.

oracle.protocol: Require null WAL to report no heap index, require a normal shared-index Wal to report false, observe null file before first append, append a committed frame, then require Pager journal-file selection to equal Wal.walFile.
internal_observations: file pointer before and after lazy open
oracle.normalization: Boolean and within-process file-pointer identity compare exactly.

assurance.oom: No allocation in observers; lazy open allocation belongs to append.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: Observers perform no I/O; caller synchronization external.
assurance.malformed_input: Nullable heap query is safe; walFile requires a typed live owner.
assurance.continuation: Pure observations preserve WAL ownership and state.

integration.production_owner: src/core/wal.zig Wal and src/core/pager.zig journal-file selection
integration.native_call_path: Pager.journalFile calls Wal.walFile before falling back to rollback journal; locking-mode policy can consume usesHeapIndex as it is ported.

independent_review.notes: Requires heap-index runtime path, pinned-C trace, assurance closure, and independent review.
